answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 32595 Country: United Kingdom Title: I'm going to divorce my wife,She is a working woman.She wants work during her iddat. Question: I'm going to divorce my wife,She is a working woman.She wants work during her iddat. The amount of money is unaffordable for a middle class man like me here in the UK. Do I have to pay her all money including house rent,councel tax,utility bills such as Gas,Electricity and water bills which will be MUCH amount of money. Please guide me as soon as possible. May Allah reward you for this Khidmat in the Duniya and after life. Answer ID: 32595 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1017/1017/M=1432) Why do you want to divorce your wife? What is the reason? You must remember that before Allah the most abominable among lawful things is talaq. This is an act which pleases the devil. One should not give talaq except in inevitable circumstances. Yes, if one fears for trampling the rights and it is difficult to maintain the guidelines set by Shariah, and there is no way to maintain the relation between the husband and wife, then one can give talaq. However, in case of talaq, it is not right for the woman to go out of home in the state of iddah (waiting period) without any need. If she has the problem of livelihood, she can go out of her home during day for as much time as needed. It is not clear which amount is out of your capacity and what is the problem with the woman to work in iddah period. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
